SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Enable Speech To Text
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Show the floating dictation button and run at startup

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Accessibility Service
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Types dictated text into focused fields. When enabled, the floating control uses a trusted accessibility overlay so protected screens, such as browser permission prompts, remain usable. When disabled, the control uses Draw over other apps instead.
